fnol_text: My name is Callum Oduya and I live at 54 Primrose Road, Springfield, OH 45530. You can reach me on (555) 212-4212 or callum.oduya@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 4 June 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00133. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Oduya on (555) 212-4212 to acknowledge the claim. Callum confirmed the loss date as 4 June 2025.
Site visit to 54 Primrose Road. Neighbour Esther Herrera was present and confirmed the timeline.
Callum sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
